name: Market Profile Initial Balance Breakout

crowd_strength: Buch von bekanntem Autor: J. Peter Steidlmayer
anti_hunt: Trailing Stop → entfernt sich vom Hunt
Re-Entry nach Hunt → nutzt Hunt als Signal

hypothesis: When price breaks the Initial Balance (first 60 min range), it signals a directional day. Extension bars with single prints confirm conviction. ~35% of days are directional.
edge_rationale: IB breakout captures trend days (~15-20% of days are strong trend). Single prints above/below IB show institutional conviction. Measured move = IB range projected from IB boundary.
best_when: Trend days, open-drive days, news-driven directional moves.
worst_when: Rotational/balanced days (false breakouts). First 15 min noise.
entry_conditions: Long: price breaks IB high + single prints above + volume increase
Short: price breaks IB low + single prints below + volume increase
Enter on first pullback to IB boundary
exit_tp_logic: Measured move: IB range projected from IB high/low. Trail behind developing POC.
exit_sl_logic: Back inside IB range (beyond IB boundary by 1-2 ticks).
reported_note: ~55% WR on IB breakouts. Only ~35% of days are directional. High R:R when trend day catches.
notes: Complement to VA Reversion. ~35% directional days. Higher R:R but fewer trades. Requires volume confirmation to avoid false breakouts.
